I've written the plan for w205 (work-queue r34–r39) with nothing left open, and the result file is marked `DONE`. Using the 2026-10-27 answer (reading A), it settles the r39 question the earlier plan had raised.

**r39 (the waiting line):** `work list` reads only this context's own record of the requests an initiative raised, kept at `.shop/work/<initiative>/raised.jsonl`. Each entry gives the upstream, the request's `q<n>`, the initiative it was raised for, and its last known status. `work list` never contacts the upstream. Each entry not yet `delivered` prints a "waiting on" line under its initiative. A raised request does not appear among the list's own request lines, and it doesn't affect when an initiative becomes `done` (r23).

- **Storage choice:** I used a `.jsonl` file beside `log.jsonl` because `model` and `workqueue.items` only read `.md` files, so neither will pick it up. A separate directory under `.shop/work/` would be read by `model` as an initiative with no `initiative.md`.
- **Gap:** nothing writes or updates this record yet, because `--raised-for` (requests r29) and supervision r135 aren't built. For now only the r39 test step writes it.

**The rest is unchanged from the earlier plan:**
- `work show` with no target keeps today's output, because requests r13 still uses it.
- `work status` stays, because w205 retires nothing.
- `show <initiative>` prints what `status <initiative>` prints today.
- A target is resolved as an initiative first, then as a work-item id; anything else is refused under r7.
- No existing test breaks.

**Files to change:**
- `scripts/work`
- a new `scripts/workqueue_list.py`, with its row in `CLAUDE.md`
- a new `tests/scenarios/work_queue_list_steps.py`
- `tests/scenarios/test_work_queue.py` (one import line)
- possibly `tests/scenarios/work_queue_status_steps.py`

The plan also lists the cases the scenarios don't cover, for the implementer to name. Two examples: whether `list --json` shows the waiting, and what happens when the record has a malformed line.

Files are in `.shop/scratch/3-plan/`:
- plan.md
- result.json
